name: Gregory M. Cokinos
tagline: Top rated Construction Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: Gregory M. Cokinos is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2026. He works at Cokinos | Young, located in Houston, Texas, and provides legal services for issues involving Construction Litigation: Business, Real Estate: Business and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gregory Cokinos completed legal studies at South Texas College of Law Houston and graduated with the class of 1982. Gregory Cokinos passed the bar in 1982.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
